summary: ConnectionProfile — database-flavored Profile subclass. Adds to_driver_kwargs() and to_connection_string() on top of the generic mountainash_settings Profile. to_driver_kwargs() delegates to __adapter__ if set, otherwise builds from descriptor driver_key mappings. to_connection_string() assembles scheme://user:pass@host:port/db from BackendSpec metadata.
extension_points: __adapter__ class var — set to a callable(profile) -> dict to override to_driver_kwargs() entirely
Subclass ConnectionProfile and set __spec__ (BackendSpec) to define a new backend settings class
lifecycle_notes: Password from PasswordAuth is accessed via SecretStr.get_secret_value() in to_connection_string().
Adapter pattern: if __adapter__ is set, it owns the full kwarg-building pipeline.
documentation_hooks: to_driver_kwargs() is the primary integration point between settings and IbisBackend
to_connection_string() URL escapes credentials with urllib.parse.quote — relevant for passwords with special chars
examples: CLAUDE.md — usage section shows to_driver_kwargs() and to_connection_string() calls
